CivicEvidenceSignificance.description: Native CIViC evidence significance, from the live EvidenceSignificance enum.

DrugSection.description: Explicit drug disclosures; identity cards never expand into these sections.
x-enum-descriptions: Paged identity cross-references and product links. MyChem includes ChEMBL ATC codes.
Native CIViC therapy evidence and profile context.
Exact label heading, application numbers and recent major changes.
Native application and product history rows.
First Drugs@FDA label PDF version with a --find match in --label-section.
DDInter partners and levels (default five per page). `levels` counts pairs across all pages. For management and mechanism text, follow `next` to the openFDA drug_interactions label field.
One row per market (Drugs@FDA, EMA, WHO prequalification). Use --source for one market.
eEML listings: core or complementary, section, indication, date added, therapeutic alternatives and Expert Committee text (default five per page).

PartialDate.description: A Gregorian date preserving year, month or day precision. The parser additionally validates the calendar day, including leap years.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: A source-selected drug request echoed with a native ID after name resolution, otherwise with the name as given.

civic_cursor.description: CIViC cursor. Continue this drug, profile and collection. Only with --source civic.

civic_kind.description: CIViC collection. Evidence or assertions in this profile. Only with --source civic.

civic_profile.description: CIViC profile. Selects a molecular profile for this drug. Only with --source civic.

decision_from.description: Earliest status date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Only with section approvals.

decision_to.description: Latest status date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Only with section approvals.

document_id.description:
Exact approval letter ID. Limits: 25 MiB, 100 pages and 6144 escaped bytes per fragment. Reports scans without text.
Only with --source drugsfda. Only with section approvals.

every_version.description: Read every version. In order up to the limit, instead of halving. Only with section label-history.

evidence_level.description:
A–E
Native CIViC evidence levels; repeat to include several levels.
Only with --source civic on get drug, and the civic section on get variant.

evidence_significance.description:
Significance
Native CIViC evidence significance, such as resistance or sensitivityresponse.
Only with --source civic on get drug, and the civic section on get variant.

evidence_status.description:
Status
Native CIViC evidence status; omitted preserves the source's existing default.
Only with --source civic on get drug, and the civic section on get variant.

find.description:
Exact label text. Repeat for OR. Ignore case and whitespace breaks. History also ignores hyphenation.
Current labels: two excerpts per section, up to five sections and five comma-separated SPL set IDs.
Only with section label or label-history.

input.description: Native source ID after name resolution, otherwise the requested name as given, spaces included.

label_section.description:
Exact openFDA SPL fields.
Separate fields (including tables) with commas for one part per field. Omit or give an absent or unknown field to list available names.
warnings_and_precautions reads warnings_and_cautions.
For drugsfda history, choose boxed_warning, indications_and_usage, contraindications,
warnings_and_cautions, adverse_reactions, drug_interactions or use_in_specific_populations.
Only with section label or label-history.

partner.description:
Interaction partner. Keep pairs matching a DDInter ID or full name (any case). Retry missing names with aliases.
Only with section interactions.

product_number.description: Application product number. Only with --source drugsfda. Only with section approvals.

section.description: Named disclosures of the selected source, each its own part of one reply; empty means identity only.
section.title: Source sections.

section_limit.description: Page size. Requires a section. Max 200 for approvals, interactions, label, regulatory, xrefs and essential-medicines, 50 elsewhere.

section_offset.description: Section offset. With label-history --every-version, start at this version. Requires a section.

title: DrugGet
